judged_rule: every run finished inside the 3-hour bound and the v3.27 summary publishes a Code quality score for each, the equal mean of Muse Spark 1.3 (muse) and GPT-6.1 Sol (sol)
single_judge_rule: combined_single_judge recomputes the combined score with Code quality from one judge's reviewed score and intent recovery alone; it is a sensitivity figure, not the published score
intent_recovery_rule: When a submission passed no quirk family, intent recovery has no denominator; no DeepSeek V4.1 Flash run needed that rule
hidden_behaviour_fields: hidden_behaviours counts the task's fail-to-pass hidden tests; hidden_behaviours_fixed counts those the run passed

cost_fields.list_usd: tokens at DeepSeek's off-peak list price, the board's $/task
cost_fields.billed_usd: the adapter's per-call meter at the time of each call, 2x in DeepSeek's weekday peak hours
cost_fields.peak_calls: model calls metered at the peak rate
cost_fields.unmetered_title_calls: dsh's session-title call, which records no usage and is not priced
cost_fields.attempts_without_usage: interrupted model replies that reported no usage, not priced

token_fields.raw_tokens: input (cached included) plus output, as dsh's receipts report them
token_fields.token_usage.output_tokens: output tokens; dsh reports no separate reasoning count

model_identity: harness-recorded: dsh records the model it requested (deepseek-flash), not the id in DeepSeek's response; DeepSeek's pricing page mapped deepseek-flash to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 before each level
